requested: review replacement of the incomplete pre-campaign v012 checkpoint payload by the canonical schema-2 Unit A identity
forbidden: mixed old and new v012 campaign state

review.scope: schema matrix, isolation, retirement, and official consumer connectivity

repository_discipline.rationale: The schema changes at the checkpoint owner and is validated at writer, reader, runner consumer, and lineage boundaries without a compatibility shim.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: One gateway owns schema and campaign lineage; generic runner and script do not interpret FADA fields.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: The additive saver dependency preserves the default runner checkpoint API.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Resolved runtime and materialized env identity flow into the learner contract, then into persistence; readers do not reconstruct identity from mutable globals.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Old partial payloads reject in the new reader, new payloads strictly round-trip, and mixed campaign identities cannot finalize.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: Because no v012 training campaign exists, the incomplete writer is retired directly instead of retaining a legacy branch.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: The offline migration validator passes; no resume, server, training, or learned-quality claim is inferred.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Schema-2 identity seals tensor dimensions and ordered layout plus asset and resolved-config hashes.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: The migration changes persistence identity only and leaves SAC optimizer ownership unchanged.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: The four-way matrix is characterized, mixed versions are forbidden, strict restoration succeeds, and exact lineage finalization is consumed through the official runner.

residual_risks.description: A schema-2 campaign is intentionally fresh-only; no v012 resume protocol is admitted.
residual_risks.disposition: Do not claim or attempt resume without a separately designed state contract.
